title: Team member closeout: Solar Soaring Star (7f0c08) — Director role complete at second succession; authority with Celestial Glowing Dusk; no claims retained
body:
Team member closeout:
- Boundary owned: Director (graph implementation team), second holder — Moment 2 at 16:22:39Z
  (event 0a3d08ff, owner-directed) to Moment 2 of my successor at 17:26:34Z (event 7f452f66).
  Before that: Director-in-waiting/understudy from 15:40Z (team-start 6143ae87).
- Outcome: authority transferred to Celestial Glowing Dusk (1e526e, claim 75323860) — route
  ALL Director traffic there from now. Tenure delivered: predecessor stall root-caused
  (Veiled watcher frozen 15:28:55Z, evidence 382ed72e) and recovered per PDR-064; #157
  comms-watch hardening MERGED (3ed24de7); #158 G4a MERGED (fa100b3a) — both with every
  bot finding first-hand-adjudicated and verdict-recorded; G4 plan todo reshaped to the
  reviewed two-tool design; two rotation waves choreographed with zero lost work (Radiant →
  Celestial Twinkling Orbit mid-cycle per PDR-063; Umbral → Airy Lifting Squall; one pickup
  contention dissolved by yield, one pre-empted by standby contract); bulk refresh recorded
  (manifest 2026-06-10T16:43Z) with the resync PR routed.
- Evidence: continuity commits 5d166e9e + e3af9b65 on docs/graph-team-direction-2026-06-10;
  merge commits 3ed24de7 + fa100b3a on main; the comms stream 15:37Z–17:27Z.
- Claims / queue / git state: my claims 8cd0de7f CLOSED (citing 7f452f66); commit queue
  empty; coordination home committed-clean EXCEPT (deliberate) the 16 regen reference-diff
  files (Airy-Squall's resync PR consumes them) and the post-e3af9b65 comms/registry churn —
  the new Director's first docs(continuity) commit picks that up (standing pattern).
- Session complete announcement: Solar Soaring Star (7f0c08) session ends here by owner
  direction.
- Retained claims: NONE.
- Pickup notification required for follow-on agent: none — the successor is active with their
  own claim; in-flight items all have named owners (Airy-Squall: resync PR + turbo micro-PR;
  Celestial Twinkling Orbit: G1b c2 completion; owner: principles-prompt attribution gate).
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: yes — follows this event immediately.
- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) an agent can be substantively active on a PR while
  comms-silent — stall diagnostics must cross-check PR work-evidence, not just the stream
  (fed back into the duty list in pre-positioning 1d8ac145). (2) The succession protocol
  survived its hardest case today: a blind outgoing coordinator; the recovery path (evidence
  -> bounded ping -> owner transport -> owner-directed Moment 2) is now worked precedent in
  the witness report §8.
- Blockers or risks: none held by me. Watch-item for the new Director: the coordination
  home's agent-tools build predates #157 — portable polling loop remains the watcher shape
  until a rebuild from a main-rebased tree.
- Handoff needed: complete — pre-positioning 1d8ac145 + acknowledgement 7f452f66 are the
  record.
